storage: append-only JSONL day-files under <archive>/treasurydts/, one file per STATEMENT date (gz after 4 days — the statement is final once published; margin covers the publish lag)
written_by: server/treasuryDts.ts archiveDtsDay (6h poll of the daily source, eager boot)
source: Treasury FiscalData API, endpoint v1/accounting/dts/deposits_withdrawals_operating_cash (Daily Treasury Statement, Table II) — fully keyless JSON. ~90 rows per business day; dataset history to 2005-10-03. Published each business day for the prior business day (~1-2 day lag). Field names verified live 2026-07-06; page[size] brackets MUST be URL-encoded (the API 400s on raw brackets)
license: US Treasury open data, public domain; attribution 'U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data — Daily Treasury Statement'
attribution: U.S. Treasury Fiscal Data — Daily Treasury Statement

field_map.record_date — day-level dedup key: one coherent statement per file; a DESC fetch straddling two business days keeps ONLY the newest (statements never mix)
field_map.account_type/transaction_type/category: TGA account, Deposits|Withdrawals, transaction_catg verbatim (withheld income/employment taxes, FUTA, corporate taxes, agency categories)
field_map.today_amt/mtd_amt/fytd_amt: $ MILLIONS as published; missing/empty values are null, never zero
field_map.src_line: source line number (stable ordering within the table)

confidence_model: RAW official daily fiscal flows. The withheld-tax payroll-nowcast hypothesis stays gate-locked: gate 1 = reconcile monthly sums vs MTS/FRED federal receipts; gate 2 = withheld-tax YoY growth vs payroll-surprise dates. Nothing is claimed until then.
cadence: daily source (each business day, ~1-2 day lag); 6h poll makes off-days a dedup no-op
_note: Universal archive envelope (approved 2026-07-04). BUILD ORDER 6 #2; the 20-year backfillable history is the accumulation moat (accumulation substitutes for purchase) — backfill is a separate session-run task, not the boot path.
